checks.fact: Ground Truth surveys independently verify timestamped LIDAR accuracy.
Ground Truth points are captured on flat unambiguous surfaces.
Ground Truth point accuracy is plus or minus 3 cm RMSE.
Ground Truth records include survey date.
Ground Truth records include surface type.
Ground Truth records include survey method.
Ground Truth records include transformation information.
Ground Truth records include geoidal model information.
Ground Truth can support multiple LIDAR surveys if age limits are met.
General Ground Truth age limit is less than 5 years.
Coastal-project Ground Truth age limit is 3 years.
LIDAR surveys must report less than plus or minus 15 cm RMSE to pass QC.
Standard deviation and random error must be within the stated 10 cm QC threshold.

promotion_rule: Exact revision 14 runtime output plus remote integrity readback is required before promoting any parcel height-difference value.
